name: A11 Qflush Check
description: Vérifie Qflush après modification des fichiers qflush

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/qflush/status' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host \"Qflush: available=$($r.qflushAvailable) flows=$($r.flows.public.Count)\" } catch { Write-Host \"Qflush: DOWN\" }"
